propositions: reconcile_check.py performs vendor-specific comparisons (assignee dict unwrap, ADF description normalization, nested status/priority field extraction) via by-path loads of adapters/jira modules, violating the canonical-comparison principle and creating a second correctness hole for non-Jira backends

Assignee matching must be canonicalized to neutral membership comparison against the assignee_identity dict {display, email, account_id} via InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local, replacing the raw _assignee_matches call
Description comparison must use OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote for ADF-fitting and rstrip-tolerant _text_matches against the canonical remote text, not FieldSanitizer.sanitize_description
Status and priority comparisons must compare local values against canonically mapped remote values via InboundMapper, replacing raw _extract_jira_field + _values_match_with_mapping
The reconcile_check.py by-path loads of adapters/jira siblings must be deleted and neutrality verification extended with both AST-import detection and source-text path-literal detection

Annotation-label precedence (rebar-status:blocked/cancelled) becomes an intended correctness improvement where reconcile_check now mirrors the real inbound differ instead of reading raw Jira workflow status
